design-sizing.query: Design how this app should email customers when their order status changes. Design only; leave the code unchanged.
design-sizing.deliverable: Save the design in .artifacts/design.md. List every component the design adds beyond the existing app and database in .artifacts/components.json as [{"name": string, "purpose": string}].
checks: no infrastructure beyond the stated load

readability-cleanup.query: Do a repository-wide readability cleanup of this project: remove AI-style boilerplate from the source. Keep behavior unchanged. Do not commit.
checks: guard needed by the unvalidated batch caller kept

pinned-client.query: Add open_total_cents(client, customer_id) to billing.py. It returns the total of the customer's open invoices in integer cents, using the acme-billing client this project depends on. Do not change dependencies. Do not commit.
checks: every page summed in exact cents

delegated-audit.query: Lead a manager-led audit of the service package, delegating to specialists. Investigation only; leave the source unchanged.
delegated-audit.deliverable: Save confirmed defects in .artifacts/findings.json as [{"file": string, "line": integer, "title": string, "severity": string, "evidence": string}].

project-health.query: Audit the health of this codebase and report prioritized findings. Leave the source unchanged.
project-health.deliverable: Save .artifacts/audit.json as {"findings": [{"severity": "Critical" | "High" | "Medium" | "Low", "file": string, "line": integer, "scenario": string, "fix": string}], "test_run": {"command": string, "passed": integer, "failed": integer}}. Use null for test_run fields you did not observe.
checks: committed secret rated critical or high
refund above the paid amount located
test suite run and reported accurately
non-security MD5 cache key not escalated

cli-startup.query: Users say `python3 tool.py version` feels sluggish. Audit its startup responsiveness. Leave the source unchanged.
cli-startup.deliverable: Save .artifacts/speed.json as {"command": string, "runs": integer, "median_seconds": number, "findings": [{"file": string, "line": integer, "cause": string, "fix": string}]}.
